raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

Fix Windows CUDA dynamic loading in `cudnn_frontend_shim.h`: use `nvcuda.dll` and `cudart64_12.dll`/`cudart64_13.dll`, and report numeric Win32 error codes only when loading or symbol lookup fails. Previously the loader used Linux library names, reinterpreted `GetLastError()` as a string pointer (causing an access violation), and could reject successful calls because of stale error codes.

## Before submitting

- [x] I ran pre-commit and reviewed the applicable AGENTS.md rules.
- [ ] Labels: `cat-bug`, `mod-backend`, `orig-external` (requested; requires maintainer permission).


<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * CUDA driver and runtime library loading now uses platform-appropriate libraries, with Windows support for CUDA runtime versions 12 and 13.
  * Improved error messages when a CUDA library or required symbol cannot be loaded, including clearer reporting when no runtime library is available.
  * Loading failures for explicitly selected runtime libraries now provide more useful diagnostic information.
<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
